fullDescription: A premium neumorphic (Soft UI) dashboard design featuring a deep, multi-layered animation system. Utilizing a sophisticated palette of soft grays and deep navys, the interface relies on calculated box-shadows to create tactile, extruded, and recessed surfaces. Optimized for SaaS management, fintech platforms, and complex data monitoring, the style combines 'Satoshi' and 'General Sans' typography for high readability. Key visual features include animated stat counters, floating icons, gradient-wave progress bars, and staggered cascading entrance animations that provide a playful yet professional user experience.

structured.summary: A highly interactive neumorphic dashboard with a light/dark mode system, utilizing convex and concave 'Soft UI' elements, vibrant accent gradients, and a comprehensive set of physics-based animations like ripples, bounces, and flows.

style.description: The design follows a strict Neumorphic (Soft UI) aesthetic where elements appear to be molded from the background. Lighting comes from the top-left, using white highlights and soft blue-gray shadows. Typography pairs 'Satoshi' (body) for clarity with 'General Sans' (headings) for character. The color palette uses #e0e5ec for light mode and #1e2030 for dark mode, accented by vibrant indigo, emerald, and rose gradients. Animations are smooth and elastic, characterized by 'cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)' timing functions for a premium, tactile response.
style.prompt: Create a Neumorphic design system. Light Mode: Background #e0e5ec, Highlight #ffffff, Shadow #a3b1c6. Dark Mode: Background #1e2030, Highlight #2a2d42, Shadow #14152a. Use Satoshi font for body text and General Sans for headings. Primary 'convex' elements (nm-flat) should have shadows: 6px 6px 12px [Shadow Color] and -6px -6px 12px [Highlight Color]. Recessed 'concave' elements (nm-inset) should have internal shadows: inset 4px 4px 8px [Shadow Color] and inset -4px -4px 8px [Highlight Color]. All interactive elements must use cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) for transitions. Implement ripple effects on click using radial-gradient overlays and 360-degree rotations for icons on hover.

layout_and_structure.description: A classic dashboard layout with a fixed sidebar (72px wide), a sticky header with breadcrumbs and search, and a responsive grid system for content cards. Content is organized into clear sections: a 4-column stat grid, a horizontal quick-action bar, and a 2-column detail area featuring activity feeds and system monitoring tools.

prompts.prompt: Design a 72px width sidebar. Top section features a convex logo card. Navigation links should be spaced 12px apart. Active state uses 'nm-inset' (recessed) styling with a subtle indigo text color (#6366f1). Hovering over links triggers a slight 'translateX(4px)' movement and a width-expanding background gradient.

Create a sticky top header (height: 72px) with a 'nm-flat' convex base and rounded corners (28px). Include a search bar using 'nm-inset' (recessed) styling with rounded-full borders. Right side contains a theme toggle button, notification bell with a pulsing rose dot, and a circular user avatar with a gradient background.

A 4-column grid of 'nm-flat' cards. Each card features: 1. A recessed icon container (nm-inset) with an icon that bobs up/down continuously (float-icon animation). 2. A large numeric value that counts up from 0 to target on page load. 3. A small trend indicator with an arrow icon. Ensure the entire card scales by 1.015 and deepens its shadow on hover.

A horizontal row of 'nm-button' elements. Each button is convex and features an icon and text. On hover, the icon should spin 360 degrees and the button should lift slightly. On active/click, the button should transition to an 'nm-inset' state with a ripple wave expanding from the cursor point.

A two-column layout. The 'Hardware Pulse' card features progress bars. Progress bars consist of a recessed track and a filled 'gradient-glow' bar. The fill should feature an animated shimmer wave (waveShimmer) and a pulsing glow effect. Include a terminal component at the bottom with a recessed background, mono-spaced text, and a blinking cursor.

special_ui_components.description: Data-driven bars with flowing gradients and glow effects.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement progress bars with 'progress-track' (nm-inset). The 'progress-fill' should be a moving gradient (e.g., linear-gradient 90deg, #6366f1, #818cf8, #a78bfa). Use an '::after' pseudo-element for a semi-transparent white shimmer wave moving at 2.5s intervals. Apply a drop-shadow glow that pulses in brightness.

Numbers should count from 0 to the target value over 1.8 seconds using an 'easeOutExpo' function. Upon reaching the final value, the number should trigger a 'countPulse' animation (scale 1.12 for 0.4s).

special_ui_components.description: Developer-centric status box with typing effect simulation.
special_ui_components.prompt: Use an nm-inset container with 'font-family: monospace'. Lines should appear with staggered delays using 'translateX(-10px)' to '0' and 'opacity 0 to 0.8'. Add a cursor-blink animation using the '▋' character.

structured.special_notes: MUST ensure that lighting consistency is maintained (highlights top-left, shadows bottom-right). MUST use the specific cubic-bezier timing for all bounce effects. DO NOT use flat borders; use shadow-based depth instead. Dark mode MUST use #2a2d42 for highlights to avoid high-contrast jarring effects.
